title: Firming up a sketch: Shop, Billing, ERP
prompt: You have a vague idea, not yet a model: a customer buys something from a shop, which somehow charges the customer via a billing system, which then talks to an ERP system. Start by capturing it as a sketch (bare `source -> destination "description"` arrows, no `workspace` block, `?` on the uncertain relationship) to see what `structurizrx` infers. Then firm the sketch up into a full, valid workspace: give every element a real `person`/`softwareSystem` kind and a one-line description, and replace the uncertain "somehow charges" relationship with a concrete description of what actually happens. Run `structurizrx validate --strict` and make sure it reports zero lint findings — no leftover placeholders or `?`-marked relationships.
